- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Mentor of — [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) — teacher who influenced him · since v2  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P38](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0038), +6 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> After walking home from school, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) panicking because [Dora](../character/dora.md) is missing, and the household fears she may have fallen into the well. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers [Dora](../character/dora.md) locked in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse and realizes [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) hid her and lied about it. When confronted, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) tearfully apologizes after realizing lying hurts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to forgive his deceit while punishing him for the prank.
>
> — v2 · X Davy in Search of a Sensation

_Sources: [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P9](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0009), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P34](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0034), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P52](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0052)_

> In a bad mood from a toothache, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally causes fireworks to explode in the schoolroom and subsequently whips [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) after he puts a mouse in her desk. She goes home heartbroken over her bad day, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comforts her. The next morning, Anthony treats [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with new respect, and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) later confirms that the whipping gained his approval.
>
> — v2 · XII A Jonah Day

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P19](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0019), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P36](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0036), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finishes the school year and walks to the graveyard, joining [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) as they share their feelings about memory, grief, and imagination. After placing flowers on the graves, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets Mrs. Allan, and they walk home together while reflecting on teaching, ideals, life choices, and the value of friendship.
>
> — v2 · XV The Beginning of Vacation

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P2](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0002), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P26](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0026), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P45](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0045)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) for tea while his grandmother is away, reassuring him about his imaginative ideas. She returns home to handle [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) before bedtime and then encounters [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) by the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble).
>
> — v2 · XIX Just a Happy Day

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P2](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0002), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P23](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0023), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P34](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0034), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)_

> During the winter at [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on the emotional barrier and occasional resentment she senses from [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), despite their shared activities and Leslie's gift of handmade baby clothes. Meanwhile, Captain Jim shows [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) his written life-book, which she realizes could be made into a great masterpiece by the right writer.
>
